summary: John's 2nd cousin 9x removed via Bull Smith (also 3C9R via Topping, formerly reported 3C8R); Revolutionary general who died a British prisoner in 1776.
bio: Path: Bull Smith → Richard 2d → Sarah (m. Nathaniel Woodhull) → Gen. Nathaniel. Captured 29 Aug 1776, denied medical care and food, died 20 Sep 1776; his death turned his cousin Abraham Woodhull against the British. Married Ruth Floyd, William Floyd's sister (her own 2nd cousin once removed). Grandfather of Eliza Nicoll Smith and great-grandfather of Judge J. Lawrence Smith.

military.note: Captured 29 Aug 1776; died a prisoner 20 Sep 1776.

media.title: Wikipedia: Nathaniel Woodhull
media.note: Nathaniel Woodhull (December 30, 1722 – September 20, 1776) was a leader of the New York Provincial Congress and a brigadier general of the New York Militia during the American Revolution.
